data.one_liner: Flutter widget to show extra text in a popup or overlay container.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display extra text in a customizable popup or overlay container by providing a context, text, and dimensions. It supports configurable size, background color, padding, and border radius.
use_when: You need to display truncated text in an expandable popup overlay.
You want a quick way to show extra text associated with a specific widget key.
avoid_when: You need full-screen dialogs or complex multi-widget navigation.
You require advanced state management or reactive UI architectures.
strengths: Easy to integrate and initialize with a widget key.
Configurable dimensions, padding, and border radius.
weaknesses: Limited to showing simple text popups.
Relies on an imperative approach via .show() method rather than a purely declarative widget tree.
